title: What portable-artifacts 0.8.0 adds
subtitle: Four changes: what each does, how it was built, and what is still unproven

sections.title: Numbers hold, builds cost less, plans get answers
sections.label: The verdict
sections.text: This release adds one-line numbers, cheap-model routing, a plan mode and the docs for all three.
points: Every test suite passed before release.
Copilot CLI ran Haiku 5.5 in 19 of 19 measured runs.
Codex and VS Code Copilot Chat are untested.

items.title: A. Numbers on one line
items.text: A number and its unit such as 42% or 1,204 ms no longer split across lines in explainers, decks, dashboards and motion.

items.title: B. Cheap-model routing
items.text: Skills hand the build to an artifact-builder agent that runs a cheaper model on Copilot and Codex.

items.title: C. Plan mode
items.text: A plan preset in make-explainer where reviewers answer decisions in the page and return a JSON file to the agent.

items.title: D. Docs and release
items.text: READMEs, feature pages and counts updated; plugin version raised from 0.7.0 to 0.8.0 for the CI guard.

sections.title: A: one token finder, many renderers
sections.label: A: how
sections.text:
`shared/nowrap.mjs` finds number-plus-unit tokens and skips `code`, `pre`, `kbd` and `samp`. The explainer wraps each hit in a `nowrap` span; motion binds the gap with a non-breaking space through an exact-match server route.

KPI tiles size their font by value length with container-query units. Long values wrap inside the tile instead of spilling. `check.mjs` measures a real browser and fails on a split or an overflow.

sections.title: B: how the cheap model is picked
sections.label: B: how

items.title: Generate agent files
items.text: `bin/agents.mjs` writes an artifact-builder agent: Haiku 5.5 with GPT-5.4 nano as fallback on Copilot, `gpt-6-luna` on Codex, low effort.

items.title: Install them
items.text: `bin/install.mjs` writes the files to the user-level agent folders; `--project` and `--agents-only` narrow it. After `npx skills add`, `doctor.mjs --fix builder_agent` writes the same files.

items.title: Tell the skill to hand off
items.text: All five SKILL.md files carry a Cheaper model block with a loop guard so the sub-agent does not delegate again.

items.title: Measure it
items.text: `eval/run-eval.mjs --agent` ran 9 smoke runs and the 10-prompt motion gate. Copilot logs confirmed Haiku in every run.

sections.title: C: plan mode has four moving parts
sections.label: C: how

items.title: Plan preset and sections
items.text: Five new section types: decision, approval, question, verdict and review, laid out decision-first with the verdict last.

items.title: Two themes
items.text: `mono` is techie with a cyan accent. `brief` is executive. The explainer now has 9 themes.

items.title: Page runtime
items.text: `plan.js` keeps answers in the browser and offers Copy, Download (`plan-answers.json`) and Save as HTML, a sticky button that saves the page with the answers inside.

items.title: Answer checker
items.text: `answers.mjs` validates the answers file, or a saved page, against a closed schema and quotes reviewer text only as data, never as instructions.

sections.title: What is still unproven
sections.text: Codex has no account here, so its agent file was written from docs only. The one hand-off trial reached Haiku, but the sub-agent was denied file access and the main model finished the work. Smoke and motion run costs were not measured.

items.risk: Wide glyphs (W, M, CJK) under 16 characters can spill a KPI tile
Stale-answers notice stays visible after the first new answer
`--force` in inline code breaks after the hyphen on every explainer page
docs/catalog.html search terms miss the new features

items.title: Spec and plan
items.text: A design spec and a 16-task plan were written and committed under `docs/superpowers/`.

items.title: One agent per task
items.text: Each task went to a fresh implementer, then a spec and quality review, then fix rounds. The controller made every commit.

items.title: Whole-change review
items.text: The strongest model reviewed the whole change, one fix wave followed, and a scoped re-review came back clean.
